items.title: Godfrey Hirsch Interview, 1987-10-27
items.q: And then, Al Hestimer was playing guitar, which, to this day, he's not a guitar player.

ctx.x: He wasn't playing boop, boop, boop. He was playing boop, boop, boop, boop.
And he was playing all of that. And then, Al Hestimer was playing guitar, which, to this day, he's not a guitar player.
Did they have any head arrangements or anything to make a difference? No. The Owls at least had that.
